title: Opt-in prompt does not state the cost and the pick modal has no way to decline after seeing the hand.
expected: UI: apps/riftbound-app/public/js/gameplay/render/modals.js:46-48 renders every opt-in pending choice as `Use ${name} ability?` with Yes/No — no cost text and no affordability gating (pay-cost extracted only at chain level, trigger-runner.ts:243). Follow-up: card def packages/riftbound-cards/src/cards/unl/insightful-investigator.ts:29-33 emits `reveal-hand` with onPicked:"discard" but no `optional: true`, so reveal-hand.ts:84-99 creates a reveal-and-pick pendingChoice without the optional flag (line 93) → only pickedCardId moves are offered; modals.js:49 titles it "Discard a card" with no skip button. The card file's own FIXME (lines 18-21) admits the XP cost gates the whole sequence rather than the post-reveal pick, so the player cannot see the hand then decline.
observed: Modal text is just 'Use Insightful Investigator ability? Yes / No' with XP=0; the follow-up modal is titled 'Discard a card' listing the 4 opponent cards with no skip/cancel option — the only moves offered were resolvePendingChoice{pickedCardId} for each card.

history.note: opt-in prompt names xp/discard cost (modals.js + decision.ts); reveal-hand pick now optional so it can be declined

resolution.note: opt-in prompt names xp/discard cost (modals.js + decision.ts); reveal-hand pick now optional so it can be declined
